verdict.rationale: Codex cloud documents opening a pull request from a finished task after you inspect the summary and diff, so the PR-creation part of the story is first-party. The evidence never explicitly documents the agent staging changes, writing commit messages, or creating branches. General command execution in the CLI is only an adjacent building block, so it earns no credit for those steps. Missing for 10: documented staging of changes, commit-message authoring, branch creation, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the PR workflow.

support.subject: As a developer, I can have the agent stage changes, write commit messages, create branches, and open pull requests

citations.quote: Inspect the summary and diff, request a follow-up, or open a pull request when the result is ready.
